title: Blood Moon Rising
body:
“Whew, this is getting stressful, it's only going to get worse...”

Description

The Blood Moon Rising Vinyl is a record that you can buy at the The Monstrous Manor for 🍬5.600 Candy, it can be put into Blue Vinyl Player or any other Vinyl player to make it play music.

This is a Limited Vinyl which could only be obtained during the 2024 Halloween and the 2025 Halloween Event.

Trivia

  • This vinyl causes in-game environmental effect of thick red fog when played.
  • This item can only be bought with Candy and only during Halloween.
  • This vinyl was made by Genisis.
  • Vinyl texture by Peekaboo.
